reproducibility_notes.pdf_determinism: ReportLab PDF generation uses InvariantCanvas and rl_config.invariant=1 with exact pinned dependencies, guaranteeing deterministic byte-for-byte PDF output (digest f4f00dff003ea41fc9945ed4e0262f11eb4b344ec6df2e4b54772e8eb42756bc) under CPython 3.12 and 3.13 on macOS Darwin arm64 with ReportLab 5.1.0. Across heterogeneous environments (e.g. Linux POSIX), ReportLab layout dimensions (612x792 pt), page count (1), and zero bounding box collisions remain strictly invariant, while binary PDF byte hashes may vary due to OS-level font rasterizers and compression libraries.
reproducibility_notes.png_rasterization: PNG rendering from PDF uses PyMuPDF (fitz) at 300 DPI (2550x3300) with explicit 300 DPI metadata. Operating system font rasterizer anti-aliasing variations and zlib compression deflate variations produce slight pixel hash variations across platforms and rebuilds, while visual geometry (2550x3300), 300 DPI metadata, layout geometry, zero collisions, and zero out-of-bounds remain strictly identical. PNGs are validated via geometry and metadata assertions and excluded from byte-level MANIFEST.sha256.
